banks.text: This programmer, working on Charles Babbage's Analytical Engine in the 1840s, is widely considered the first computer programmer.

banks.name: Space Exploration
banks.text: This astronaut, commander of Apollo 11, became the first person to walk on the Moon in July 1969.

banks.name: Classic Literature
banks.text: This English playwright, born in Stratford-upon-Avon, wrote tragedies including Hamlet, Macbeth, and Othello.

banks.name: World Cinema
banks.text: This 1954 Japanese film by Akira Kurosawa, about villagers hiring warriors to defend against bandits, inspired the Western remake The Magnificent Seven.

banks.name: World Geography
banks.text: This mountain range, the longest continental mountain range in the world, runs along the western edge of South America.
